panel.introduction: Europa is an icy moon of Jupiter. Its fractured surface and magnetic signature provide strong evidence for a salty ocean beneath the ice.

controls.label: Monochrome
controls.description: USGS Voyager/Galileo mosaic. Source resolution varies from about 200 m to 20 km per pixel. Gray grid marks documented no-data and its resampled boundary. Original image shading remains; globe lighting is approximate.
controls.title: USGS Voyager/Galileo mosaic. Source resolution varies from about 200 m to 20 km per pixel. Gray grid marks documented no-data and its resampled boundary. Original image shading remains; globe lighting is approximate.
controls.summary: Voyager and Galileo images with detail from 200 m to 20 km per pixel. Shadows remain; gray grid: no imagery.

controls.label: Enhanced color
controls.description: Galileo enhanced color: 756 nm → red, 559 nm → green, 404 nm → blue, at 1.4–1.6 km per pixel. Color covers part of the surface. A correction for each observation reduces broad photographed shading; oblique views retain observed monochrome. Overall brightness is matched to the monochrome base, preserving color ratios. Photographed shadows and seams can remain; added globe lighting is approximate. Gray grid marks gaps in both sources.
